mapper.select: select row_number()over() as seq, doi.sku_no, doi.item_name, case when #{type} = 1 then sum(doi.quantity) when #{type} = 2 then sum(doi.quantity * doi.sell_price) else 0 end sumSecondMonthSale from dmp_order_item doi left join dmp_order_info doio on doi.order_id = doio.id where to_char(doio.platform_create_time,'YYYYMM') = to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'YYYYMM') group by doi.sku_no,doi.item_name;
